source_prompt_norm: 本地模型很慢，怎麼把 rtx 3060 上的回答加速

risk_families.reason: slow path or repeated work risk

tokens: 先判斷是否有熱路徑等待
reusable_steps: 先判斷是否有熱路徑等待、重複計算、同步 I/O、queue 或 timeout。
把模型工作分成 hot path、teacher slow path、cache/reflex replay 三層。

bridges.evidence: Route slow symptoms to hot files, symbols, queue/retry/cache patterns, and UMA evidence.
Do not let broad UMA preload or model calls enter the hot path.
Answer repeated intents from reflex/provider cache and queue Qwen for slow refresh.
Keep local LLM generation out of user-facing hot path unless benchmark-proven.

answer_pattern: 先把問題分成熱路徑與慢路徑。熱路徑只做 cache/reflex/Rosen family route。慢路徑用 teacher 模型補完。把 teacher 的診斷步驟蒸餾成可重用 recipe，之後同類問題先套用 GPU、VRAM、context、batch、cache、背景 worker 的檢查順序。
boundary: recipe accelerates a problem family; it is not exact prompt replay
